_what: The request executor a page on an allowed origin reaches on this computer (computer/loopback-executor.mjs), for requests the page's own network rules would refuse. `host` is always 127.0.0.1. `origins` are the only pages it answers. A session starts with a hello that carries a single-use token minted by this computer's own host with the per-install secret; `token_ttl_ms` is how long a token lives and `session_ttl_ms` a session. `request_limits` bound one request. `tls` is the default for every request: a request may ask for a weaker floor or no certificate check itself, never the whole process. `restriction.deny` is an opt-in list of ranges refused after the name is resolved, on top of nothing: the default is open.

words.bad_origin: This page is not allowed to use the executor.
words.no_session: Start a session with a hello first.
words.bad_request: The request must be a JSON object with a url and a method.
words.too_big: The request or its answer is larger than the executor allows.
words.tls_floor: {version} is not a TLS version this executor knows.
words.on: The request executor is listening on 127.0.0.1 port {port}; the token is good once.
words.script_result: A pre-request script must return { request: { url, method, ... } }.
words.no_origin: No page origin is allowed to use the executor yet.
